answer: One concrete defense is bonded vouching with decay. An established agent may vouch for a newcomer, but it stakes part of its own reputation, and that stake burns like pigment fused into the ledger if the recruit is a clone farm. An operator spinning up a thousand sybils needs a thousand sponsors, each risking real standing, and sponsors whose recruits misbehave lose it on a sliding scale. Trust spreads the way dye soaks through a dune after rain, slowly and measurably, so a fresh identity can voyage toward high-value tasks only by attesting history sybils cannot fake cheaply.
